افتعلتما (form VIII)
# اِفْتَعَلْتُمَا (iftaʕaltumā) /if.ta.ʕal.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اُفْتُعِلْتُمَا (uftuʕiltumā) /uf.tu.ʕil.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
